name: Dhanuka Agritech Ltd
tagline: Established, almost debt-free agrochemicals maker with decent ROE but weak 5-year growth and a live Rs 121 Cr GST demand dispute
business_overview: Dhanuka Agritech is an Indian agrochemicals (crop protection/pesticides) company, promoter-held at ~70%, positioned as a domestic branded-generics player in insecticides, fungicides and herbicides.
fundamentals_narrative: Decent ROE (18.62%) and a clean, almost debt-free balance sheet, but 5-year sales growth of only 7.8% is weak for a name this screen is looking for. Market cap has fallen ~35.9% over the past year, suggesting the market has already priced in the growth slowdown and/or the GST dispute below.
technical_read: Search snippet 52-week range (Rs 999-1,015) looks unreliable/stale — not independently verified this pass; treat with caution.
sentiment_summary: Moderately active VP thread (46 replies, most recent Dec 2025) — thread activity is thin relative to company size, and the most recent post is about the GST issue below rather than a growth thesis.
community_signal: prashanth_vishwanath (Dec 2025, 0 loves) posted that Central GST Ahmedabad issued a Rs 121.32 Cr demand order (Rs 60.66 Cr tax + equal penalty) alleging Dhanuka's fertiliser/bio-stimulant products (taxed at 5%, HSN 3101) should be classified as Plant Growth Regulators (HSN 3808, 18% GST) — a live, material tax dispute (~45% of annual profit) rather than a bull/bear conviction call.
bse_notes: GST demand order (Rs 121.32 Cr) reported Dec 2025 — a tax/regulatory dispute distinct from SEBI action, but material enough to flag explicitly; outcome/appeal status not confirmed this pass.
bull_case: Almost debt-free balance sheet with 18.62% ROE
70% promoter holding, stable, well-established branded agrochemicals franchise
Stock already down ~36% over 1 year — some bad news may be priced in
bear_case: 5-year sales growth of only 7.8% is weak — no clear re-acceleration catalyst surfaced
Live Rs 121.32 Cr GST demand/penalty (~45% of annual profit) is a real near-term overhang, pending appeal outcome
Agrochemicals is a generic-pricing-pressure, monsoon-dependent, regulation-heavy sector
At Rs 4,577 Cr market cap, this is already a mid-sized company — a 10x/100x re-rating needs a much sharper catalyst than current fundamentals show
verdict_headline: Clean balance sheet, but weak growth and a live Rs 121 Cr GST dispute — not a multibagger setup
verdict_reasoning: 18.62% ROE and near-zero debt are genuine positives, but 7.8% 5-year growth doesn't support a 10x/100x thesis
Rs 121.32 Cr GST demand is a real, material overhang not yet resolved
Pass for now; would need to see the GST matter resolved and a growth re-acceleration to reconsider
red_flag_reason: Live Rs 121.32 Cr GST demand/penalty dispute (not a SEBI/securities-regulator action, so doesn't meet the strict EXCLUDE bar, but material and worth tracking)

four_box.note: 18.62% ROE/near-zero debt genuine but verdict explicit '7.8% 5-year growth doesn't support a 10x/100x thesis'; Rs121.32cr GST demand is a live overhang; no moat/valuation detail.
